page.title: Student and parent records
page.intro: Choose what your school records about each student and each parent. Staff fill the records in; parents never enter anything. Changes are drafts until you publish them.

sensitive.hint: This label looks like an ID number, a passport or medical information. Consider marking it sensitive:

sensitive.permission: Only school leadership can reveal the full value, with a separate permission.
sensitive.logged: Every reveal and every download is logged: who, when, and which field.
sensitive.retention_one: It is deleted automatically {{count}} month after the person leaves the school, unless you set another period.
sensitive.retention_other: It is deleted automatically {{count}} months after the person leaves the school, unless you set another period.
